name: Protopasta Carbon Fiber PCTG
filament_notes:
High Impact (gray, ~20% stronger and 115% stiffer than unfilled PCTG) and High Strength (black, ~45% stronger and 250% stiffer) carbon-fiber PCTG.
Product pages: 255C and up (they print up to 275C; 255C is a good compromise), 70-80C+ bed, about 2 mm3/s; reduce flow below 100% and add a nozzle wipe at layer change if material builds up on the nozzle.
This profile currently uses 250C, 80C plate and a 12 mm3/s cap - raise the nozzle toward 255C. Carbon fiber is abrasive - use a hardened nozzle. Use Magigoo or glue stick.
